name: Cracked Gait
description: Break the rhythm of the walk into cracked uneven paces that carry the user out of a set line.

name: Rupture Palm
description: Drive a palm that ruptures the neat flow of qi in the guard arm of the target.

name: Fragment Guard
description: Break the incoming blow into fragments on a forearm of loose qi and let them fly wide.

name: Disjoint Kick
description: Kick at the knee of the foe with a jolt of wild qi that pulls the joint out of true.

name: Unraveling Touch
description: Touch the foe as a technique forms and pull at its threads until the whole of it comes undone.

name: Cadence Wreck
description: Strike off the cadence of the exchange so the foe's trained sequence stumbles and ends.

name: Pattern Undoing
description: Gather chaos qi for several breaths then release it so every pattern-bound technique near the user falls apart.

name: Cascading Ruin
description: Land a run of blows that each break the guard the previous blow opened until nothing is left to hold.

name: Wearing Touch
description: Rub chaos qi into the foe's guard arm so its order wears thin and it begins to shake.

name: Frail Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves the struck place frail so the next blow goes deeper.

name: Erosive Step
description: Step so that the ground under the foot loses its hold and the foe's footing erodes beside it.

name: Crumble Guard
description: Let the force of the blow crumble through the forearm into loose grit that falls away.

name: Entropic Drain
description: Hold the foe and let their qi lose its order bit by bit until their techniques come out weak.

name: Ebb Grip
description: Close a hand on the foe's arm and let the strength ebb out of the muscle under it.

name: Crumbling Blow
description: Strike a wearing blow that loosens the bones and tendons it touches and leaves them crumbling.

name: Entropic Flood
description: Draw entropy into the palm and loose it as a surge that ages every guard and weapon in front of the user.

name: Ruinous Touch
description: Press a fingertip to one point of the foe and send ruin through every meridian in a single beat.

name: Jarring Shock
description: Jolt the living field of qi around the body so a quick shock runs through all within it.

name: Anarchy Step
description: Move through the field by no fixed rule so no foe inside it can predict the next pace.

name: Unruly Guard
description: Throw up a guard of qi that bucks and shifts against each blow and refuses to be struck cleanly.

name: Lawless Palm
description: Strike with a palm that follows no school or form and lands where the foe has no answer.

name: Roil Sense
description: Feel the roil of the field to learn where in it a foe stands and how they stir the qi.

name: Churning Tumult
description: Churn the field so every foe in it finds their qi flow and their balance unsteady.

name: Anarchic Bolt
description: Loose a bolt of unruly qi that wanders in its flight and then drives home against the target.

name: Mutiny Touch
description: Touch the foe so that their own limbs answer to a different order than the one they give.

name: Anarchy Grip
description: Hold the whole field in violent disorder so that foes within it cannot form a clean technique.

name: Total Overthrow
description: Pull in the field then fling it outward and overturn every standing guard and held technique.

name: Capricious Step
description: Change direction on a whim in mid pace so the user ends well away from the strike.

name: Whim Strike
description: Strike from whichever side the foe watches least at that instant with no plan set beforehand.

name: Fitful Guard
description: Raise a guard in fits and starts so the blow lands on empty air or a hard edge at random.

name: Wayward Jab
description: Send a jab off to one side then recall it with a snap of qi into the exposed ribs.

name: Sudden Reversal
description: Turn the foe's own striking force round in an instant and return it as a blow to their side.

name: Caprice Burst
description: Burst a squall of qi that changes strength and direction as it spreads and strikes foes unevenly.

name: Mercurial Grip
description: Take hold of the foe's limb with a grip that slides and tightens in turns and cannot be broken at once.

name: Fickle Tempest
description: Gather a tempest of shifting force over several breaths and drop it on foes from changing directions.

name: Volatile Blow
description: Wind up a blow whose force may be small or terrible and set it off at the instant of contact.

name: Tumult Step
description: Burst forward through a swirl of loose qi and arrive at the foe's flank in a confused blur.

name: Clamor Fist
description: Pound a fist that rings with noisy chaos qi and shakes the guard it lands on.

name: Bluster Guard
description: Fill the space before the body with a roaring bluster of qi that blows lesser blows astray.

name: Hubbub Elbow
description: Whirl in close amid a hubbub of qi and drive an elbow into the unguarded centre.

name: Calm Breaker
description: Burst out of perfect stillness with a shove that shatters the foe's composure.

name: Tumult Wave
description: Roll a wave of tumultuous qi outward that tosses foes about and breaks their formation.

name: Tumult Rush
description: Rush through the foe's line in a rolling tumult and leave their stance scattered behind.

name: Din Burst
description: Send out a deafening din of qi that dulls the foe's senses and muddles their aim.

name: Sapphire Tumult
description: Hold still then release a roaring tumult that overwhelms all within it and scatters their formation.

name: Riot Surge
description: Keep up a surging riot of blows that grows more violent with each breath of the exchange.

name: Hairline Step
description: Slip along a hairline crack in the foe's attention and be gone before it closes.

name: Crack Palm
description: Strike so that a web of cracks runs through the qi layer guarding the target.

name: Skyward Fray
description: Fling a hand upward so a fraying line of qi rises and cuts through any cast technique above.

name: Splay Guard
description: Splay the fingers wide so a blow breaks across them and turns aside in several directions.

name: Fracture Sense
description: Feel along the qi field for the faint cracks that show where a foe's technique will fail.

name: Gapped Strike
description: Hit through a gap in the foe's field that the user has just torn open with a quick pull.

name: Riven Snare
description: Open a rift of torn qi under the foe's feet and hold them where their field cannot reach.

name: Splitting Wedge
description: Drive a wedge of focused chaos qi into a foe's field and split it down the middle.

name: Cleaving Disorder
description: Cleave the air with a blade of disorder that scatters the ordered qi it passes through.

name: Brittle Sky
description: Make the air around the foe brittle so every technique they gather splinters before it leaves them.

name: Sky Fracture
description: Crack the field overhead in a great spreading web and rain broken force on all beneath it.

name: Rending Shear
description: Shear the foe's field away from their body and keep it torn while the user presses the advantage.

name: Gale Skitter
description: Skitter sideways on wind-flicked steps that no foe in a ranked line can track.

name: Ruffle Palm
description: Strike with a palm that ruffles the foe's qi like a gust through loose cloth.

name: Scrambled Guard
description: Scramble the guard into a swirl of crossed forearms that no single blow can read.

name: Muddy Pace
description: Stir the foe's sense of distance with a muddy pulse that makes them step wrong.

name: Order Breaker
description: Smash into the front of an ordered line and throw its spacing into disarray.

name: Disarray Pulse
description: Pulse disorder through the ground so a group loses its step and its shared timing.

name: Gale Disarray
description: Raise a gale of mad force that shoves foes in contrary directions and sunders their order.

name: Contrary Wind
description: Meet a barrage with a blast of contrary wind and chaos that turns the volley round on those who sent it.

name: Whimsy Step
description: Skip across the field on steps chosen by whim so no mark of intent shows in the body.

name: Caprice Palm
description: Strike with a palm that decides its target only in the last finger's width of the swing.

name: Waver Guard
description: Waver the forearm in the path of a blow so it strikes where the arm has just left.

name: Mood Reading
description: Read the swings of a foe's qi field to learn when their intent is about to change.

name: Whirl Snap
description: Whirl once inside the field and snap out a blow from the angle the foe thought was shut.

name: Flighty Veil
description: Hold a veil of flighty qi that spoils the aim of any technique cast toward the user.

name: Random Gust
description: Throw a gust of ragged qi that veers at random in flight and strikes from an unexpected side.

name: Caprice Surge
description: Fill the field with shifting whims of force so that foes cannot hold one plan from breath to breath.

name: Fate of Gusts
description: Let the wild gust choose where the blow falls then drive the field's whole weight behind it.

name: Unbridled Step
description: Throw off the fixed stride of the school and step by no pattern the foe has seen.

name: Vowless Palm
description: Strike with a palm bound to no form and no oath so it meets no guard built to stop it.

name: Loosened Ward
description: Let the ward hang loose about the body so blows pass through its give instead of breaking it.

name: Unfix Touch
description: Touch a held stance and unfix it so the foe's feet slide from the position they chose.

name: Slack Sense
description: Feel which of a foe's forms are fixed and which are loose enough to be undone.

name: Binding Undone
description: Pull on a binding or hold laid on the user and cause its threads to slacken.

name: Undone Posture
description: Strike the centre of a held posture so its whole structure comes loose at once.

name: Unmaking Veil
description: Spread a veil of unmaking qi that weakens every sworn or fixed technique held under it.

name: Fraying Oath
description: Strike a fixed guard and fray the sworn pattern that holds it together.

name: Oath Unmade
description: Unmake every fixed form in the field at once so stances give and wards open and sworn holds slip.

name: Formless Hammer
description: Bring down a blow with no shape that no stance can brace against and no guard can name.
